message: ベジタ・ブルー

name: Synn
message: 「Hello~」

name: Misa
message: 「Crunch... munch, munch...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ugh.」
For some reason, Misa was there looking terribly grumpy.

name: Synn
message: 「I wonder if everyone else... hasn't arrived yet.」

name: Misa
message: 「Even though you're the president, you don't even keep track of the members' schedules?」

name: Synn
message: 「Other classes are a bit...」

name: Misa
message: 「Big Sister should be at her club activities.」

name: Synn
message: 「And Lolotte...」

name: Misa
message: 「She's probably loitering around somewhere. Crunch... ugh.」

name: Paqy
message: 「Bragging about keeping track of things like that makes you a total laughingstock.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, I don't want to hear that from you, Sakura-kun.」
I didn't say anything, though I do need to reflect on it.

name: Synn
message: 「Stop it, Paqy. Misa seems to be in a bad mood for some reason.」

name: Paqy
message: 「She's definitely close to her period.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-W-What an insensitive thing to say!!」
Still, I have to do something about this stagnant atmosphere before everyone gets here.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Misa. Is there something... bothering you, or some kind of trouble? Anything like that?」

name: Misa
message: 「How rude. Everything is going completely smoothly.」
She scribbles away with her pen, yet there's no irritation felt in the pressure of her strokes.

name: Misa
message: 「Even if there were, I wouldn't have anything to consult you about. I can handle it myself.」
Her sharp tongue is nothing new, but she's in an even worse mood than usual.

name: Misa
message: 「...Crunch... ngh.」
Come to think of it, her expression twists even more the moment she puts food in her mouth.
She takes small nibbles, dips it in Thousand Island dressing, and brings it to her mouth again.
What she's eating are those vegetable sticks sold at convenience stores and the like. Though I've never eaten them.

name: Synn
message: 「Does what you're eating not taste good?」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「The thing you're eating, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「You mean this?」
Misa points at the thing held in her mouth. Making a dry, moistureless sound, the cucumber snapped.

name: Synn
message: 「Don't tell me you actually hate them or anything...」

name: Misa
message: 「O-O-Of course not!! I'm not a kid, hating vegetables or anything like that」

name: Synn
message: 「Then it really is a problem with the taste... That's it, freshness is what matters most for vegetables!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Excuse me?」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait right here!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh! They've grown nicely!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sorry to keep you waiting」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha...! Where did you get those」

name: Synn
message: 「Ta-da~! Homegrown, freshly picked vegetables」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What about vegetables. Ha!!」

name: Misa
message: 「I see. Are you trying to imitate me or something? Not a shred of originality, huh」
Offering me dressing while looking triumphant, Misa really is a kind girl after all, I think.

name: Synn
message: 「Too bad, though. That's not it--these are a present for working so hard, Misa」

name: Misa
message: 「For me? Stop that, I don't need anything like that」

name: Synn
message: 「You've been making a weird face while eating for a while now. So a lightbulb went off」

name: Misa
message: 「Wha-what!? Excuse me for that!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I figured you must want to eat some fresh vegetables, Misa!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Say whaaat!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Let's see... daikon radish, carrots, cucumbers. Look, they're the exact same ones you bought, Misa, but--」
Snap♪

name: Synn
message: 「This sound right here!! You just gotta have this, after all」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun... could it be that you went out of your way just for that...?」

name: Synn
message: 「There's also celery, asparagus, broccoli, and more. Dressing is good too, but definitely try enjoying their raw flavor. It's guaranteed to be delicious!」

name: Misa
message: 「O-Of all things, it had to be that lineup...?」

name: Synn
message: 「Come on, eat them while they're still fresh and crisp. I washed them thoroughly, after all」

name: Synn
message: 「Don't worry. The asparagus and broccoli are properly boiled」

name: Misa
message: 「That's not the problem!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Could it be you hate them?」

name: Misa
message: 「As if that could ever be the case!? Don't treat me like a child!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Then go right ahead!」

name: Misa
message: 「What a predicament... He went through the trouble of bringing them, so it'd be rude not to eat... but...」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you that worried? They're completely pesticide-free, so you're safe. Me, Nanaka, and Paqy all eat them too」

name: Misa
message: 「Paqy-san eats vegetables!?」

name: Synn
message: 「He's an omnivore even though he's a panda, it's pretty funny」

name: Misa
message: 「It's a classic tactic. Using a popular character to try and cure a hatred of vegetables」

name: Synn
message: 「So you do hate them after all?」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm telling you I don't!!」
Misa grabs a stalk of celery and tosses it into her mouth.
Water splatters with a crisp snap.

name: Synn
message: 「How is it? How is it?」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't look at me with sparkling eyes! When you stare at me like that, there's no way I can answer honestly!!」

name: Misa
message: 「If I was going to do this anyway, I should've gone with the cucumber...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ba-dump, ba-dump...」

name: Misa
message: 「It's delicious! It's so delicious! It's way too delicious! Will that do!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ooooh, thank goodness~~」

name: Misa
message: 「It's so fresh the flavor is super strong... though it's definitely good for beauty...」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're crying」

name: Misa
message: 「It's just so delicious that I'm moved to tears, that's all!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I see, I see. There's still plenty more, so eat up」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't mind if I do!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Hisss...」

name: Synn
message: 「Man~. I'm just glad you liked it. With this, our Student Council activities will go off without a hitch!」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Here, take this」

name: Synn
message: 「Hm? Veggie sticks?」

name: Misa
message: 「I make it a point to repay a favor right away」

name: Synn
message: 「You're giving these to me?」

name: Paqy
message: 「They're leftovers」

name: Synn
message: 「How could you say that about Misa's kindness? Thanks! I won't hold back」

name: Misa
message: 「Phew...」

name: Synn
message: 「Hoho~~. These are good in their own way!」

name: Misa
message: 「It really comes down to the dressing--without the dressing...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah, sorry. It was so good I already used it all up」

name: Synn
message: 「Veggies really are delicious!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-Is that so... Good for you」
